GetPersistentData.description: Gets the value of a "slot" from the selected persistent data realm.

fields.name: realm
fields.description: The data realm to select. `OBS_WEBSOCKET_DATA_REALM_GLOBAL` or `OBS_WEBSOCKET_DATA_REALM_PROFILE`

fields.name: slotName
fields.description: The name of the slot to retrieve data from

SetPersistentData.description: Sets the value of a "slot" from the selected persistent data realm.

fields.name: realm
fields.description: The data realm to select. `OBS_WEBSOCKET_DATA_REALM_GLOBAL` or `OBS_WEBSOCKET_DATA_REALM_PROFILE`

fields.name: slotName
fields.description: The name of the slot to retrieve data from

fields.name: slotValue
fields.description: The value to apply to the slot

GetSceneCollectionList.description: Gets an array of all scene collections

fields.name: sceneCollectionName
fields.description: Name of the scene collection to switch to

CreateSceneCollection.description: Creates a new scene collection, switching to it in the process.

fields.name: sceneCollectionName
fields.description: Name for the new scene collection

GetProfileList.description: Gets an array of all profiles

fields.name: profileName
fields.description: Name of the profile to switch to

CreateProfile.description: Creates a new profile, switching to it in the process

fields.name: profileName
fields.description: Name for the new profile

RemoveProfile.description: Removes a profile. If the current profile is chosen, it will change to a different profile first.

fields.name: profileName
fields.description: Name of the profile to remove

GetProfileParameter.description: Gets a parameter from the current profile's configuration.

fields.name: parameterCategory
fields.description: Category of the parameter to get

fields.name: parameterName
fields.description: Name of the parameter to get

SetProfileParameter.description: Sets the value of a parameter in the current profile's configuration.

fields.name: parameterCategory
fields.description: Category of the parameter to set

fields.name: parameterName
fields.description: Name of the parameter to set

fields.name: parameterValue
fields.description: Value of the parameter to set. Use `null` to delete

fields.name: fpsNumerator
fields.description: Numerator of the fractional FPS value

fields.name: fpsDenominator
fields.description: Denominator of the fractional FPS value

fields.name: baseWidth
fields.description: Width of the base (canvas) resolution in pixels

fields.name: baseHeight
fields.description: Height of the base (canvas) resolution in pixels

fields.name: outputWidth
fields.description: Width of the output resolution in pixels

fields.name: outputHeight
fields.description: Height of the output resolution in pixels

GetStreamServiceSettings.description: Gets the current stream service settings (stream destination).

SetStreamServiceSettings.description: Sets the current stream service settings (stream destination).

fields.name: streamServiceType
fields.description: Type of stream service to apply. Example: `rtmp_common` or `rtmp_custom`

fields.name: streamServiceSettings
fields.description: Settings to apply to the service

GetRecordDirectory.description: Gets the current directory that the record output is set to.

SetRecordDirectory.description: Sets the current directory that the record output writes files to.

fields.name: recordDirectory
fields.description: Output directory
